name: Suzuki Bandit 600
engine: 599 cc oil-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: A simple, popular four. Frame rust and seized rear suspension linkages are the big things to check.

add.title: Free up the rear suspension linkage
add.instructions: Strip the rear linkage, clean and grease the bearings, and replace any that are seized.
add.reason: Seized linkages are a known weak spot on the Bandit and costly if left.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Rust and linkages
known.what: Frame rust is common, and seized suspension linkages are a known weak area.
